preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4), representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(n.is_integer() and 2 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2*10^5), representing the number of vertices in the tree.
Each of the n-1 lines following n contains three integers p_j, a_j, b_j (1 ≤ p_j ≤ n; 1 ≤ a_j, b_j ≤ 10^9), where p_j is the parent of vertex j, and a_j, b_j are edge values.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(p_j) <= n for p_j in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: For each edge, p_j is a valid vertex number (1 ≤ p_j ≤ n), ensuring the tree is correctly rooted at vertex 1.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == n-1 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly n-1 integers, corresponding to r_2, r_3, ..., r_n.

postconditions.expression: all(r_i.is_integer() and 0 <= r_i <= path_length for r_i, path_length in zip(output_line.split(), [len(get_path_to(i, tree)) for i in range(2, n+1)]))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i (2 ≤ i ≤ n), r_i is a non-negative integer (0 ≤ r_i ≤ path_length), where path_length is the length of the path from root (1) to i. r_i is the length of the maximum prefix of this path such that the sum of b_j along this prefix does not exceed the sum of a_j along the entire path.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(b_j for b_j in get_prefix_b_sum(path_to_i, r_i+1)) <= sum(a_j for a_j in get_path_a_sum(path_to_i)) for r_i, path_to_i in zip(output_line.split(), [get_path_to(i, tree) for i in range(2, n+1)]))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i, the sum of b_j along the first r_i+1 edges of the path to i must not exceed the sum of a_j along the entire path to i.

postconditions.expression: all(not exists(r_i+1 < len(path_to_i) and sum(b_j for b_j in get_prefix_b_sum(path_to_i, r_i+2)) <= sum(a_j for a_j in get_path_a_sum(path_to_i))) for r_i, path_to_i in zip(output_line.split(), [get_path_to(i, tree) for i in range(2, n+1)]))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i, r_i is the maximum possible length such that the sum of b_j along the first r_i+1 edges of the path to i does not exceed the sum of a_j along the entire path to i.
